spec.title: AI-Native Lean card D — Differential and characterization experiments

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Classify behavioral differences against the independent specification.

p.APPLICABILITY: A new implementation or model may differ from an earlier one.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Consumer-owned implementation/model corpus and recorded exact input identities.

p.SCOPE: A general implementation/model differential harness is WISH in 0.1.0. Matching an old defect is not acceptance; the runner does not issue G2 or G3.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A direct theorem is stronger for its proved domain; old/new comparison is useful for migration diagnostics.

p.RISKS: A corpus can miss cases or make current behavior normative; retire that oracle when its assumption no longer applies. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES.
